notes.title: Common Meeting Room Booking
notes.description: Shared office note used as low-signal link filler
notes.body: Book shared rooms through the calendar and cancel unused slots the day before so other teams can use them. Rooms with video units are reserved for calls with more than four remote participants.

notes.title: Common Travel Request Form
notes.description: Shared office note used as low-signal link filler
notes.body: Submit travel requests two weeks ahead with the destination, purpose, and estimated cost. Late requests need a manager note and are settled at the standard rate only.

notes.title: Common Laptop Setup Guide
notes.description: Shared office note used as low-signal link filler
notes.body: New laptops get full-disk encryption, the password manager, and the VPN client on the first day. Return the loaner unit within a week of receiving the permanent machine.

notes.title: Common Visitor Badge Rules
notes.description: Shared office note used as low-signal link filler
notes.body: Visitors sign in at reception, wear a badge at all times, and are escorted inside secure areas. Badges are returned at departure and reprinted for each visit.

notes.title: Common Printer Maintenance
notes.description: Shared office note used as low-signal link filler
notes.body: Replace toner when the panel warns and write paper jams in the shared sheet. The facilities team services every printer on the first Wednesday of the month.

notes.title: Common Holiday Calendar
notes.description: Shared office note used as low-signal link filler
notes.body: Office holidays follow the national calendar plus two company holidays in August. Teams with on-call duty swap the company holidays for a weekday of their choice.

notes.title: Common Desk Booking Etiquette
notes.description: Shared office note used as low-signal link filler
notes.body: Book a desk before arriving and release it if plans change. Leave the desk clear at the end of the day so cleaning staff can wipe every surface.

notes.title: Common Coffee Machine Care
notes.description: Shared office note used as low-signal link filler
notes.body: Descale the machine monthly and refill beans from the pantry stock. Report a blinking service light to facilities instead of pressing the reset button repeatedly.

notes.title: Common Parking Allocation
notes.description: Shared office note used as low-signal link filler
notes.body: Parking spaces change hands quarterly among teams and bicycles use the basement racks. Visitors park in the two marked bays next to the entrance.

notes.title: Common Mailroom Hours
notes.description: Shared office note used as low-signal link filler
notes.body: The mailroom is open from nine to five and packages are held for 72 hours. Outgoing parcels need the cost centre written on the label.

notes.title: Common Lost and Found
notes.description: Shared office note used as low-signal link filler
notes.body: Lost items are kept at reception for one month and then donated. Valuables are locked in the cabinet and released only with a matching description.

notes.title: Common Wellness Program
notes.description: Shared office note used as low-signal link filler
notes.body: The wellness program offers gym discounts and quarterly health checks. Enrolment opens in January and again in July for new joiners.

notes.title: Common Library Loans
notes.description: Shared office note used as low-signal link filler
notes.body: Library books can be borrowed for four weeks and extended once. Reference volumes stay in the reading corner and are not lent out.

notes.title: Common Kitchen Cleaning Rota
notes.description: Shared office note used as low-signal link filler
notes.body: Kitchen cleaning follows the weekly rota posted on the fridge. The last person leaving on Friday empties the dishwasher and takes out the recycling.

notes.title: Common Supply Cabinet
notes.description: Shared office note used as low-signal link filler
notes.body: Stationery is in the supply cabinet; write what you take on the clipboard. Bulk orders go through the office manager once a month.

notes.title: Lumen Backup Rotation
notes.body: Lumen backup rotation runs every Monday. Rotate the weekly media set, run the restore drill, and note the media ID in the drill record: [lumen restore drill](/notes/lumen-restore-drill.md).

notes.title: Operations Compendium Volume Two
notes.body:
## Tundra restore checksum verification
After a checksum mismatch, rotate the tundra vault secret and re-run the restore verification before reopening writes.
## Weekly operations digest
The weekly digest gathers capacity numbers, ticket counts, and vendor updates from every team lead, then publishes a one-page summary on the intranet before the Monday stand-up so that nobody has to read the raw dashboards.
## Vendor contact handover
Vendor contacts rotate every six months; the outgoing contact introduces the incoming one by email, shares the escalation matrix, and hands over the open purchase orders together with the price list.

notes.title: Kestrel Retention Decision
notes.body: Kestrel retention is 90 days because the reuse sample showed no access after day 90 and storage cost doubles beyond that point.

notes.title: Reuse Sample Spring
notes.body: Sample of forty kestrel objects: thirty-one were reused within 92 days and none after day 90.

notes.title: Nightly Purge Job
notes.body: The nightly purge job deletes kestrel objects older than 90 days and writes the count to the job log.

notes.title: Lattice Archive Tier Decision
notes.body: Lattice archive tier is cold storage because restore requests are rare, about three per quarter, and the warm tier costs four times more.

notes.title: Restore Request Tally Q2
notes.body: Tally of lattice restore requests in Q2: three requests, all served within a day.

notes.title: Lattice Tiering Job
notes.body: The lattice tiering job moves objects to cold storage after sixty days without access.

notes.title: Nimbus East Failover Policy
notes.body: East region failover: promote the standby within five minutes, keep the DNS TTL at sixty seconds, and require manual approval before traffic moves.

notes.title: Nimbus West Failover Policy
notes.body: West region failover: promotion is automatic within two minutes, the DNS TTL is thirty seconds, and no manual approval is needed.

notes.title: Cobalt Batch Retry Policy
notes.body: Retry policy for cobalt jobs: retry three times with exponential backoff, alert after the third failure, and write the incident. Batch jobs additionally pause the queue.

notes.title: Cobalt Stream Retry Policy
notes.body: Retry policy for cobalt jobs: retry three times with exponential backoff, alert after the third failure, and write the incident. Stream jobs additionally drop the offending message.

notes.body: 棚卸 地域別確認記録。担当、対象倉庫、照合方法、差異の扱い、報告先を共通テンプレートに沿って記す。件数が合わない棚は再集計してから確定する。地域固有事項は大阪例外として、港湾倉庫の集計を午前中に実施する。

queries.codex: lumen backup rotation の定例確認
queries.claude_code: lumen backup rotation を確認して報告
queries.routine: 定例チェックを開始します。以下の手順を順番に確認し、結果を所定の形式で報告してください。対象外の項目は省略せず「該当なし」と記載します。確認が完了したら要約を作成し、未完了の項目があれば次回へ持ち越します。前回からの変更点があれば差分として明示し、担当者と実施した曜日を末尾に添えてください。報告は箇条書きで簡潔にまとめ、参照したノートへのリンクを付けます。判断に迷う項目は保留とし、一行で状況を書き残してください。対象システムの担当者へ結果を共有し、必要な対応があれば次の定例までに着手できる形で整理してください。今回の確認対象は lumen backup rotation です。
